objective: 围绕现有 PCB 与制造工程发布，生成可复现的采购、质量与硬件现场验证包。
acceptance: procurement package has a controlled BOM, quote-request register, supplier scorecard, cost/lead-time model, PO checklist, and inventory policy without inventing supplier quotes
quality package has test standards, inspection plan, FMEA, defect workflow, AQL plan, compliance matrix, and explicit evidence gates
validation package has SIM2REAL matrix, diagnostic SOP, 20 fault scenarios, first-batch acceptance template, and long-run protocol with unexecuted results clearly marked
automated validators produce deterministic reports and hardware package tests pass
stop_conditions: 供应商报价、采购订单、实物样品、实验室认证或真机测量属于外部证据，在获得之前必须保持阻断
任一候选元器件缺少已批准的 AVL Owner
验证结果将需要声称某项测试已在没有签名证据记录的情况下执行
